guarantees.claim: err_o is driven to 1'b0 if sel_chk matches any of MUX6_SEL_0..MUX6_SEL_5, and to 1'b1 for any other value (default).

assumptions.claim: The driving logic for sel_chk must only assert one of the six legal MUX6_SEL values during normal operation.
assumptions.risk: If sel_chk takes an illegal value, err_o will be asserted, potentially triggering a false alarm or system safety response.

uncertain_points.claim: The 'unique case' directive may cause synthesis to treat the default branch as unreachable, potentially optimizing err_o to a constant 1'b0 and removing the error detection logic.
uncertain_points.cond: During synthesis with optimizations enforcing 'unique case' semantics.
uncertain_points.risk: Illegal sel_chk values would go undetected in silicon, leading to silent data corruption or security bypass.

uncertain_points.claim: It is unclear whether all six MUX6_SEL values are reachable from the driving state machine; if some are unused, the check may never be exercised for certain missing cases, potentially hiding a real error.
uncertain_points.cond: When the driving logic never produces some of these values.
uncertain_points.risk: Coverage gaps in error detection; an illegal state that maps to an unused legal value would not trigger err_o.
